claims.text: Lily was a daughter of Balbo Baggins and Berylla Boffin. She married Togo Goodbody and had many descendants.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Baggins of Hobbiton"

claims.text: During the last years of her life, the Shire suffered from the Fell Winter, and around that time she lost her elder brother Ponto. Lily died the next year, as did her other brother, Largo.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Third Age"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Baggins of Hobbiton"
